title: Add bounded clarification loop for vague instructions
measurement_note: Timing was started after web-first intake and memory bootstrap, so early phases are not measured.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Completed before the timing record existed.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.bottleneck_notes: Included requirement baseline, change/review records, and spec artifacts.

phases.label: Policy and workflow updates
phases.bottleneck_notes: Included usage profile, operating model, workflow, prompt, router, index, persistent instructions, AGENTS, and memory bootstrap updates.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Included JSON syntax, config contract, memory bootstrap, docs, naming, structure, workspace index, task board, workspace health, grounding, evaluator, and diff whitespace checks.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.bottleneck_notes: Included grounding check, work evaluator, and paired evaluation report creation.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Measured the primary implementation commit and push. A follow-up metadata commit records finalized close-out references.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The visible measured work is evenly split between governance artifacts and policy/profile updates.
improvement_candidates: If similar operating-rule changes continue, automate the requirement/spec/history scaffold.
Keep clarification policy examples in a reusable prompt test set if this pattern repeats.
